title: Fuzzy clock to speak up on demand
line: The Fuzzy Clock's context menu has a new "Read Time Aloud" item that speaks the current fuzzy time.
explanation: The Fuzzy Clock had no way to speak the time, so people who rely on audio could not use it, and the reporter wanted it to speak only when asked. This adds a "Read Time Aloud" context menu action that speaks the same fuzzy text the clock shows through Qt TextToSpeech (speech-dispatcher on Linux). The speech engine is loaded only the first time the action is used, and the action hides itself if the QtTextToSpeech module or a speech engine is missing.

commits.message:
applets/fuzzy-clock: add an action to read the time aloud

The fuzzy clock could only be read on screen, which made it of little use
to people who rely on speech. This adds a "Read Time Aloud" item to its
context menu that speaks the current fuzzy time using Qt TextToSpeech.

BUG: 337944

patches.diff:
From 6328c95a875d32625ef4898171c75ba04e984e05 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Nov 2026 12:39:28 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/fuzzy-clock: add an action to read the time aloud

The fuzzy clock could only be read on screen, which made it of little use
to people who rely on speech. This adds a "Read Time Aloud" item to its
context menu that speaks the current fuzzy time using Qt TextToSpeech.

BUG: 337944
---
 applets/fuzzy-clock/CMakeLists.txt      |  1 +
 applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/TimeSpeaker.qml | 12 ++++++++++++
 applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/main.qml        | 18 ++++++++++++++++++
 3 files changed, 31 insertions(+)
 create mode 100644 applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/TimeSpeaker.qml

diff --git a/applets/fuzzy-clock/CMakeLists.txt b/applets/fuzzy-clock/CMakeLists.txt
index 43f8b7457..b4dda56e0 100644
--- a/applets/fuzzy-clock/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/applets/fuzzy-clock/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -7,6 +7,7 @@ plasma_add_applet(org.kde.plasma.fuzzyclock
         qml/config.qml
         qml/FuzzyClock.qml
         qml/main.qml
+        qml/TimeSpeaker.qml
     RESOURCES
         main.xml
     GENERATE_APPLET_CLASS
diff --git a/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/TimeSpeaker.qml b/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/TimeSpeaker.qml
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..58b91d6b3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/TimeSpeaker.qml
@@ -0,0 +1,12 @@
+/*
+ * SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2026 Niccolò Venerandi <niccolo@venerandi.com>
+ *
+ * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+ */
+
+import QtQuick
+import QtTextToSpeech
+
+TextToSpeech {
+    readonly property bool available: state !== TextToSpeech.Error
+}
diff --git a/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/main.qml b/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/main.qml
index 45e41a6be..63fe76d6d 100644
--- a/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/main.qml
+++ b/applets/fuzzy-clock/qml/main.qml
@@ -38,6 +38,24 @@ PlasmoidItem {
         trackSeconds: (root.compactRepresentationItem as FuzzyClock).mouseArea.containsMouse
     }
 
+    Loader {
+        id: speakerLoader
+        active: false
+        source: "TimeSpeaker.qml"
+    }
+
+    Plasmoid.contextualActions: [
+        PlasmaCore.Action {
+            text: i18nc("@action", "Read Time Aloud")
+            icon.name: "audio-speakers-symbolic"
+            visible: speakerLoader.status !== Loader.Error && (!speakerLoader.item || speakerLoader.item.available)
+            onTriggered: {
+                speakerLoader.active = true;
+                speakerLoader.item?.say((root.compactRepresentationItem as FuzzyClock).timeString());
+            }
+        }
+    ]
+
     compactRepresentation: FuzzyClock {
         property bool wasExpanded: false
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Master: the Fuzzy Clock's context menu has no way to hear the time.
With the fix: "Read Time Aloud" at the top of the context menu.
Master: the clock can only be read on screen.
With the fix, with sound: choosing "Read Time Aloud" at 12:38 speaks "Twenty to one", matching the label.
